support_claim: CRM record OAK-77 names Oakfield Logistics, commercial notes state that entity rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH with unchanged HRB 88421 while CRM retains the old English-facing name, the registry lists Oakfield Logistik GmbH at HRB 88421, and billing invoices use that same legal name.
justification: Under the identity contract, SAME_ENTITY is licensed because the packet supplies establishing evidence of legal continuity (unchanged HRB 88421 through rebrand), an explicit CRM-to-legal-entity linkage (CRM still shows the pre-rebrand English-facing name), and matching registry and billing names for the post-rebrand legal counterparty—not merely compatible or similar names.
